  constructor(arr) {
    this.index = 0;
    this.arr = arr;
  }

  first() {
    this.index = 0;
    return this.next();
  }
  
  next () {
    const result = this.arr[this.index];
    this.index++;

    return result;
  }
  
  hasNext() {
    return this.index < this.arr.length;
  }
}
